[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-j5[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Fix done-notes archiving without changing the done/ layout[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob task archive` moves only what it should, from notes that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]should feed done/, at a predictable time, through a writer as safe [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]as `bob task move`. Archive pairing survives renames, every Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]path check agrees on what done/ means, and an archived task can [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]come back with one command or one plugin gesture.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/done_notes_archiving_fixes.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-j5/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Safe archive selection[/bold #D7AFFF]                                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]selection[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]selection: restrict archiving to area and project notes, never move ^prj[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lines or roots with open subtasks or open parents, ignore fences, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]comments, and frontmatter, read closed statuses from Tasks settings, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]start the docs/task-archive.md contract.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Guarded archive writer with preview and JSON[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]guarded-writer[dim] · [dim][/dim]after selection[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guarded-writer: run every archive write under the shared lock through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the guarded write engine with stale checks, recovery, replay detection, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pre-apply verification, and same-write regrouping; add -n/--dry-run and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]-f/--format json.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Correct archive link repair[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]link-repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]after guarded-writer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]link-repair: carry renamed block IDs into local links, qualify same-note[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]heading links, skip code, follow the shared case rules, and hold blocks [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with duplicate IDs instead of silently skipping their repair.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One archive pairing resolver, rename-following, and health [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]diagnostics[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]pairing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after link-repair[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pairing: add one metadata-first source/archive resolver, move every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]filename-derived caller onto it, follow source renames per the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rename_following decision, and report orphan, duplicate, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]open-in-archive, duplicate-ID, and undated-row diagnostics.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Keep window and month headings[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]keep-window[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pairing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]keep-window: replace the count gate with the chosen keep window, keep -t[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]as an optional minimum batch, file new roots under close-month headings,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and confirm the rule with a read-only live-vault dry run.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob task restore[/bold #D7AFFF]                                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]restore[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pairing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]restore: let the task-move engine take a done/ source and add a thin bob[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task restore that defaults to the bound source, optionally reopens, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refuses recurring occurrences, merge tombstones, and ^prj lines.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One done/ path contract in bob-cli[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]path-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]after keep-window, restore[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]path-contract: replace every Rust done/ path predicate, inline check, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and walker skip with one first-component, case-sensitive helper pinned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]by shared test vectors.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plugin path helper and archived-task reopen[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]plugins[dim] · [dim][/dim]after path-contract, restore[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plugins: give each bob-plugins plugin that checks done/ paths the same [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]helper pinned to the shared vectors, and route reopening an archived [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task per the plugin_reopen decision.[/#D7D7AF]
